meta.name: lean-analytics
meta.description: Choose and audit startup metrics using Croll and Yoskovitz's "Lean Analytics". Use when the user mentions "what metrics should we track", "KPIs", "north star metric", "One Metric That Matters (OMTM)", "vanity metrics", "analytics dashboard", "DAU/MAU", "churn benchmark", or "measure product-market fit". Also trigger when choosing metrics for a startup or feature, auditing a dashboard for vanity metrics, setting metric targets and baselines, or instrumenting a product by business model and stage. Covers good-vs-vanity metrics, the One Metric That Matters, metrics by business model, the five startup stages, and benchmarks. For the build-measure-learn loop, see lean-startup. For fixing activation and retention, see improve-retention.

copy.tagline: 根据商业模式和阶段选择并审计创业指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在创业或做产品，需要确定该跟踪什么指标。
copy.tagline_en: Choose and audit startup metrics by business model and stage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building a startup or product and need to decide which metrics to track.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的业务模式和阶段，帮你选出当前最重要的一个指标（OMTM），并区分哪些是真正有用的指标、哪些只是虚增数字的虚荣指标。
howto.when: 当你询问该追踪什么指标、提到“北极星指标”或“OMTM”、想审计仪表盘中的虚荣指标时触发。

say.text: 帮我为我的SaaS创业公司选一个OMTM。
say.note: Claude 会基于SaaS模型和阶段推荐一个关键指标。

say.text: 审计我的仪表盘，找出虚荣指标。
say.note: Claude 会检查并建议将总量指标改为比率。

say.text: 设定一个指标目标，包括达标线和未达标的应对方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you select the One Metric That Matters (OMTM) based on your business model and stage, and distinguishes actionable metrics from vanity metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask what metrics to track, mention "north star metric" or "OMTM", or want to audit a dashboard for vanity metrics.

say_en.text: Help me choose an OMTM for my SaaS startup.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend a key metric based on SaaS model and stage.

say_en.text: Audit my dashboard for vanity metrics.
say_en.note: Claude will review and suggest converting totals to ratios.

say_en.text: Set a metric target with a line in the sand and miss response.
say_en.note: Claude will help define a target with number, date, and pre-committed action.
